courseDetails.title: Bien-être au quotidien : environnement, habitudes et plaisir
courseDetails.shortDescription: Aménage ton espace, démarre avec des mini-habitudes et retrouve du plaisir dans tes routines, sans outil compliqué.
courseDetails.longDescription:
Se sentir mieux au quotidien ne demande pas forcément de bouleverser toute sa vie. Parfois, ce sont les petits changements répétés qui rendent nos journées plus simples, plus agréables et plus faciles à vivre.

Dans ce cours, tu vas explorer des méthodes concrètes pour agir sur trois dimensions de ton quotidien : ton environnement, tes habitudes et le plaisir que tu accordes à tes journées.

Pas besoin d’une organisation complexe ni d’une transformation radicale. L’objectif est au contraire de commencer petit, d’expérimenter et de conserver progressivement ce qui fonctionne pour toi.

Crée un environnement plus agréable

Ton environnement influence la manière dont tu vis et abordes tes journées.

Tu découvriras plusieurs pistes simples pour améliorer ton cadre de vie : désencombrer ton espace grâce à un test sur trois mois, mettre en place un ménage plus régulier, adapter la lumière de tes pièces et choisir plus consciemment les contenus auxquels tu t’exposes.

L’objectif n’est pas de créer un environnement parfait, mais de réduire certaines sources de friction pour rendre ton quotidien plus agréable.

Passe à l’action avec de petites habitudes

Nous avons souvent tendance à vouloir changer trop de choses en même temps. Dans ce cours, tu découvriras une approche différente : réduire l’effort nécessaire pour commencer.

Tu apprendras notamment à :

  • laisser une nouvelle idée mûrir avant de t’engager ;

  • identifier les actions qui peuvent avoir le plus d’impact ;

  • utiliser les mini-habitudes pour commencer plus facilement ;

  • appliquer la règle d’une minute ;

  • préparer ton matériel à l’avance pour réduire les obstacles au démarrage.

L’idée n’est pas de devenir parfaitement discipliné, mais de rendre certaines actions suffisamment simples pour avoir envie de les commencer.

Remets davantage de plaisir dans tes journées

Le quotidien ne devrait pas être uniquement une succession de tâches à accomplir.

Tu verras comment réserver de vrais moments pour toi dans ton agenda, rendre certaines activités moins agréables plus plaisantes, limiter les sources d’information qui affectent inutilement ton humeur et accorder davantage d’attention aux moments passés avec tes proches.

Tu découvriras également une méthode simple pour faire le bilan de ta journée et choisir une petite amélioration concrète à expérimenter dès le lendemain.

Deux articles pratiques complètent le parcours pour t’aider à prendre du recul face aux petites contrariétés et à construire des rituels du matin et du soir adaptés à ton propre rythme.

Expérimente plutôt que de tout changer

Chaque leçon se termine par une action concrète que tu peux tester dans ta propre vie.

Tu n’as pas besoin d’appliquer toutes les idées du cours. Choisis-en une ou deux qui correspondent à ta situation, expérimente-les pendant une semaine et observe ce qu’elles changent réellement pour toi.

L’approche de ce cours est simple : moins de grands changements difficiles à maintenir, davantage de petites actions faciles à essayer et à intégrer progressivement.

Ce cours s’adresse à toute personne qui souhaite améliorer certains aspects de son quotidien avec une approche pratique, progressive et sans outils compliqués.

Les exemples partagés par l’instructeur — lieux, applications, horaires ou voyages — proviennent de son expérience personnelle et correspondent à la période d’enregistrement. Ils sont à adapter à ta situation, ton budget, ton travail et ta santé. Les horaires de sommeil éventuellement mentionnés illustrent son fonctionnement personnel et ne constituent pas une recommandation médicale.

Ce cours propose des pistes de réflexion et d’expérimentation autour du bien-être quotidien. Il ne remplace pas l’avis d’un professionnel de santé et ne garantit aucun résultat particulier.
targetAudiences: Toute personne qui souhaite se sentir mieux au quotidien grâce à des habitudes simples
Les personnes qui repoussent leurs projets personnels faute d'énergie ou de temps
Celles et ceux qui veulent un intérieur plus apaisant et des routines plus agréables

courseDetails.title: Herkes İçin Yapay Zekâ Okuryazarlığı: İşte Güvenle Kullanın
courseDetails.shortDescription: Yapay zekâ nasıl çalışır, işinize nerede uyar, nasıl iyi ve güvenli kullanılır — bir saat, gerçek ChatGPT gösterimleri
courseDetails.longDescription:
Bu kursta yapay zeka kullanılmıştır.

Bir saat. Her çalışan. Jargon yok. Herkes İçin Yapay Zekâ Okuryazarlığı, üretken yapay zekâyı geliştirmek değil, işte kullanmak zorunda olan kişiler için kısa ve stüdyo kalitesinde bir giriştir. Beyaz tahta animasyonuyla çizilmiştir ve her araç gösterimi bir canlandırma değil, gerçek bir ChatGPT oturumudur (ekrandaki arayüz İngilizce, anlatım Türkçe).

Kullanım eğitimi geride bıraktı: çalışanların yaklaşık yarısı artık işinde yapay zekâ kullanıyor, ancak yalnızca üçte biri kendini yeterince eğitimli hissediyor. AB'de Yapay Zekâ Yasası'nın 4. maddesi, yapay zekâ kullanan her kurumdan çalışanlarının yeterli düzeyde yapay zekâ okuryazarlığına sahip olmasını sağlamasını istiyor; zorunlu bir biçim yok ve yapılan eğitimin kaydının tutulması öneriliyor. Bu kurs o kayıt olacak şekilde tasarlandı.

Neler öğreneceksiniz

  • Yapay zekâ gerçekte nedir — kurallar ile veriden öğrenilmiş örüntüler arasındaki fark ve "üretken" ne demek
  • Nasıl çalışır — sonraki kelimeyi tahmin, bağlam, bilgi kesim tarihi ve yanılırken bile neden emin konuştuğu
  • İş gününüzde zaten nerede — asistanlar, yerleşik kopilotlar ve görünmez yapay zekâ
  • Beş gündelik iş canlı gösteriliyor: özetleme, taslak hazırlama, yeniden yazma, beyin fırtınası, açıklama
  • Dört parçalı istem — bağlam, görev, kısıtlar, biçim — zayıf bir istem ekranda onarılarak gösteriliyor
  • Önce geliştirin, sonra doğrulayın — yeniden istem yerine takip sorusu ve uydurma bir bilgiyi canlı yakalayan iki dakikalık kontrol
  • Gizlilik ve mahremiyet — isteme asla neyin girmeyeceği ve kendi ChatGPT veri kontrollerinizi nasıl kilitleyeceğiniz
  • Önyargı, şeffaflık ve hesap verebilirlik — ABD, Kanada, Avustralya ve AB'den gerçek, adı verilmiş vakalar
  • Kopilot zihniyeti — taslak, gözden geçir, sahiplen — ve bunu alışkanlığa dönüştüren 30 günlük bir plan

Her şey gerçekçi tek bir işyerine dayanıyor: 320 kişilik bölgesel bir gıda dağıtıcısı olan Larkspur Foods. Bu işyerini üç meslektaşın gözünden görüyoruz: yapay zekâyı kullanmak zorunda olan destek sorumlusu, ondan kuşku duyan operasyon müdürü ve kurumu güvende tutmakla görevli insan kaynakları sorumlusu.

Kursa dahil olanlar: 16 ders (yaklaşık bir saat), 4 gerçek ChatGPT gösterimi, 2 sınav, tam çözümlü 1 uygulamalı ödev ve indirilebilir Yapay Zekâ Okuryazarlığı Özet Rehberi — istem kartı, yap/yapma kartı, iki dakikalık doğrulama kontrolü, 20 terimlik sözlük, 30 günlük plan ve eğitim kaydınız işlevi gören Yapay Zekâ Kullanım Kartı.

Kursun sonunda yapay zekâyı gerçek işlerde güvenle kullanacak, güvenmeden önce kontrol edecek ve sınırların tam olarak nerede olduğunu bileceksiniz.

Why people risks surprise the company

A payroll mistake goes out to the whole staff. A key person leaves with no successor. A manager is accused of discrimination. A new hire turns out to have a history nobody checked. Each of these looks like bad luck, and each was a known risk that nobody wrote down, scored or assigned to an owner. Risk management in HR is the habit of doing exactly that before the event.

What changes after this course

You have a list of people risks with a probability, an impact and an owner for each. You know which controls belong to managers, which to HR and which to audit. You notice the early signs of fraud and misconduct. You measure what used to be a feeling: turnover risk, engagement, pay gaps. You have a plan for a crisis. And you make people decisions with a method that reduces bias.

What is inside: 369 tools, counted lecture by lecture

You do not have to take this number on trust. Open any lecture and read its description: every tool inside is listed there by name.

  • 209 ready-to-use tools inside the presentations:
  • 47 question lists and scripts: risk culture audit, board conduct traffic-light assessment, risk assessment, exit interviews
  • 44 templates and sample documents: anti-bribery policy, conflict-of-interest policy, non-retaliation policy, risk register with mitigation actions
  • 41 checklists: workplace privacy principles, emergency action plan essentials, individual fraud warning signs, good risk culture criteria
  • 32 step-by-step procedures and workflows: six-stage incident investigation, risk-controlled hiring process, premortem analysis, code of conduct adoption
  • 27 scorecards, rubrics and matrices: probability-impact risk heatmap, HR risk consequence classification, fraud controls by defence line, dismiss or retain decision matrix
  • 18 formulas and metric sets: annualized turnover calculation, workload-based workforce forecasting, HR initiative cost-benefit analysis, promotion versus external hiring costs
  • 155 models and methods explained with examples, including ISO 31000 risk management, the three lines of defence and the fraud triangle
  • 5 services and apps shown on screen: Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Loom, LinkedIn and ChatGPT

Where the tools are

  • HR risk management core (5 sections, 65 tools). Human risk, ISO 31000 models, psychology of risk behavior, the mitigation plan, executive risk, risk culture, roles, decisions and personal ethics.
  • HR metrics for people risk (64 tools). Recruitment, engagement, pay, performance and turnover metrics.
  • Business and financial risk acumen (63 tools). Environment analysis, competition, regulation, technology and financial statements.
  • Strategic HR risk and governance (122 tools). HR strategy, HR audit, organizational development, culture, workforce planning, rewards, international HR.
  • Anti-crisis HR (69 tools). Hiring in a crisis, payroll and benefits control, development without a budget, downsizing, bad-news communication, contingency plans.

What this course is not

It is not legal advice and not an ISO certification. ISO 31000 is used here as a framework for thinking about HR risks. For a legal question in your country, ask a lawyer.

Who is teaching

I am Mike, the #1 HR instructor on Udemy, with 1,800,000+ course enrollments from 170,000 students, and the author of about 200 books on Amazon. I built the people system at Preply as it became a unicorn and worked at Wargaming, iDeals and Alfa-Bank across 20 years in HR. I hold PHRi, SHRM-CP and HCI sHRBP certifications and represent HRCI in Eastern Europe.

I have met most of these risks in person. At a television channel with many vacancies, hiring a fraudster was a likely risk, and the security service brought it close to zero. Payroll mistakes happened, often not in favor of employees. A letter with everyone's salaries went to the wrong address. An employee dismissed without cause went to court. The same channel had work with fire, at height and with high voltage, so the company hired a very experienced safety specialist from a large plant and paid him well above the usual level. He could walk onto a set and say: stop, I forbid this. That is what a real control looks like.

How to use the course

Watch the first five sections in order: they give the risk method. Then open the area where your risks are. Section and lecture titles show how many tools are inside, and each lecture description lists them by name.

Where to start

Free AZ-900: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals Course  | AZ-900, Microsoft Azure Fundamentals AZ900, Azure AZ900, AZ-900


Prepare for the Microsoft AZ-900: Azure Fundamentals Certification Exam with a comprehensive course designed to help you understand Microsoft Azure cloud concepts and successfully pass the AZ-900 certification.


Whether you are new to cloud computing or an IT professional looking to validate your cloud knowledge, this course will help you learn the core Microsoft Azure services, cloud computing models, identity and security concepts, governance tools, and pricing structures used in Azure.


These practice tests will help you:

• Simulate the real AZ-900 certification exam experience

• Identify weak areas before taking the exam

• Strengthen your understanding of Azure cloud concepts

• Improve your exam readiness and confidence


The practice tests are ideal for learners who want hands-on exam preparation with realistic certification questions.


AZ-900 Exam Domains Covered

This course follows the official Microsoft AZ-900 skills outline, ensuring complete coverage of the certification exam topics. The AZ-900 exam measures your knowledge across three major domains.


Describe cloud concepts (25–30%)

Describe cloud computing

  • Define cloud computing

  • Describe the shared responsibility model

  • Define cloud models, including public, private, and hybrid

  • Identify appropriate use cases for each cloud model

  • Describe the consumption-based model

  • Compare cloud pricing models

  • Describe serverless

Describe the benefits of using cloud services

  • Describe the benefits of high availability and scalability in the cloud

  • Describe the benefits of reliability and predictability in the cloud

  • Describe the benefits of security and governance in the cloud

  • Describe the benefits of manageability in the cloud

Describe cloud service types

  • Describe infrastructure as a service (IaaS)

  • Describe platform as a service (PaaS)

  • Describe software as a service (SaaS)

  • Identify appropriate use cases for each cloud service type (IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS)
